claim: Coordinator-run same-host qualification of the published Codex SDK/CLI 0.160.0 pair recorded strict-hash installation under CPython 3.13.15 and uv 0.12.17, matching bundled/npm-platform binaries, and completed native-account SDK, gateway SDK and gateway CLI marker canaries with the available usage and CLI exit status retained in the linked qualification artifact.
limitations: Coordinator-recorded native-account and gateway qualification on the existing host only; not new-host or model-quality acceptance.
Gateway backend model and effort were not read from the call log; configured/requested routes and efforts do not prove backend selection.
The shared host launcher, daemon and production prefix still run 0.159.3 until a separate coordinated switch.
The 0.159.3 queue, Hindsight and October 1 SDK receipts retain their original scope; they do not qualify 0.160.0.
No stdout/stderr hashes, SDK caller exit codes, CLI token usage, gateway backend usage or monetary cost were supplied in the qualification facts; these remain unrecorded.
SDK last and total usage snapshots match for each canary and must be counted once; cached input and reasoning output are subsets, not additional tokens.
No unchanged upstream test suite, shared daemon restart, cleanup/recovery acceptance, package signature or provenance attestation verification is recorded here.
The move is inside the seven-day cooldown recorded in docs/decisions/2026-09-25-workstation-sota-refresh.md, as the prior 0.159.2 and 0.159.3 moves were (docs/decisions/2026-09-27-model-currency.md).
This repository change records existing coordinator qualification; it performs no new model run or shared-host switch.
